'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Thomas Whaley LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I'm Back Bitch
* '''Username:''' Thomas Whaley
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
